# Podstack Documentation

> Podstack is the console at https://podstack.ai. GPU instances are billed per second from the hourly rate, from boot until you terminate them. Extra disk is billed per GB-hour. Jobs are billed only while they run. Inference is billed per token from a prepaid wallet. There is no monthly or annual subscription. Prices show in INR for India and USD elsewhere. The OpenAI-compatible API is https://api.podstack.ai/v1 with keys that start with ps_live_.

## Products

- [GPU Cloud](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/gpu-cloud/): dedicated machines. Formerly QuickPod.
- [Launch an instance](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/gpu-cloud/launch-a-pod/)
- [Instances and SSH](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/gpu-cloud/instances/): SSH hostnames that Podstack assigns are on cloud.podstack.ai.
- [Jobs](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/jobs/): a script on a GPU until it finishes. Formerly TrainPod.
- [Inference](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/): base URL https://api.podstack.ai/v1, bearer ps_live_..., example model podstack/kimi-k3.
- [Endpoints](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/endpoints/): Hugging Face models on dedicated GPUs that scale to zero.
- [Functions](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/functions/): pip install podstack-sdk, PODSTACK_API_KEY=ps_live_...
- [Deploy](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/deploy/): ready-to-run apps. The catalog is live in the console.
- [Reservations](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/reservations/): quoted clusters of 16 to 1,024 GPUs.
- [Billing and wallet](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/billing/): Razorpay top-ups. Cards, UPI, and netbanking.

## Account

- [API keys](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/account/api-tokens/)
- [SSH keys](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/account/ssh-keys/)
- [Team](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/account/team/)
- [Support](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/support/)

Live model ids and rates: https://podstack.ai/app/models and GET https://api.podstack.ai/v1/models. Live GPU rates: https://podstack.ai/#pricing.
